visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with slightly messy dark hair wears a white T-shirt and blue boxers while using a white electric toothbrush. He is in a brightly lit room with a brown acoustic guitar hanging on a white wall. A large round wall clock and a smart home interface are visible. A white rolling cart and a green golf bag stand in the foreground. (2) The scene cuts to the man wearing Outfit A: a black pinstriped blazer with light blue denim patchwork accents and a matching grey denim-like skirt. He poses by turning his body, running hands through his hair, and adjusting the jacket lapels. The background remains the same indoor setting. (3) The scene transitions to Outfit B: a long, heavy coat featuring dark blue and light blue denim patchwork with printed white text patterns. He pairs this with blue denim trousers. He folds his arms, looks at the camera with a serious yet playful expression, and shows the side profile of the coat. (4) The scene shifts to Outfit C: a very large, sleeveless, chunky knit vest with grey, blue, and black horizontal fuzzy stripes. He flexes his biceps to show off the armholes and smiles. He then poses with hands behind his back, looking directly into the lens. (5) A close-up series shows accessories: a silver Horage luxury watch with a black face and visible mechanical movement, a silver ring and pendant shaped like a demonic mask, and finally, a teal-colored Oringo shoe box which is opened to reveal a pair of black leather lace-up boots.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the high-frequency buzzing sound of an electric toothbrush. A male voice with a clear, friendly tone announces his nomination for the Golden Bell Awards and his dilemma about what to wear. A medium-tempo, upbeat pop BGM with electronic drum beats starts playing in the background. (2) Following a whoosh transition sound, the male voice describes Outfit A from the brand Story Wear. He notes the coolness of the skirt design. The BGM remains steady with a 4/4 beat. The vocal delivery is casual and rhythmic, matching the lighthearted mood of the video. (3) A soft pop SFX marks the transition to the description of Outfit B. The speaker describes the coat as heavy but textured and comfortable like a quilt. The acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a studio-processed field recording with minimal background noise. (4) Another transition sound leads to the description of Outfit C. The speaker humorously compares it to primitive man attire due to the knit texture. His voice pitch slightly rises in a teasing manner. The BGM instrumental layers remain consistent without major variations. (5) The sound of rustling paper and metallic clicks accompanies the display of accessories. The speaker enunciates brand names like Horage and Oringo with professional clarity. The incidental noises of handling the watch and box are crisp and well-integrated into the mix. (6) The video concludes with the speaker asking the audience to help him choose between A, B, and C. The BGM volume slightly swells before fading out into silence as the narration ends.
